svg.title: Why a chart cannot show every point: points per pixel column
svg.desc: Left: a dense signal across a chart, with one narrow pixel column highlighted. Middle: that column zoomed in, holding thousands of points, of which only the highest and lowest set the drawn line. Right: the screen draws one vertical stroke from the lowest to the highest point.
svg.text: 10 million points on a 1,920-pixel-wide chart: about 5,200 per pixel column
The orange strip is one pixel wide
